blockers: Required real microphone and Italian transcription observations are still NOT_RUN on Windows PC, Android Chrome and iPhone Safari. The U03 contract explicitly says that mocks cannot replace a required physical result.
qolFindings: The production build retains the existing warning for JavaScript chunks over 500 kB.
resolvedReviewFindings: Text typed while assets load or recording is active is appended safely instead of being overwritten by the transcript.
The visible state order is now permission, asset loading, recording, processing and editable review.
Loading progress now uses aggregate model progress instead of per-file events that could jump to an incorrect percentage.
Automated coverage now includes Scarta, cancellation during loading and processing, late-result suppression, exact permission timing and transient-load retry.
Closing the note sheet during review now discards the unconfirmed generated text; only the explicit Usa testo action accepts it.
The note dialog now traps forward and reverse keyboard focus, supports Escape and restores focus to its opener.
Browser coverage now includes 200% text and a 320x420 reduced-height editing surface as a virtual-keyboard stress proxy.
The installed Transformers runtime source defines and emits aggregate progress_total events, including a final 100% update after caching.
A deterministic PCM WAV fallback lets the production audio boundary run in the Playwright WebKit environment where Web Audio is unavailable.
summary: The final code, deterministic checks and responsive browser evidence are ready. Closure is intentionally refused until the mandatory physical microphone checks are recorded on PC, Android and iPhone.
